response.original_title: {Official FAQ’} How do I add another passenger to my Norwegian Cruise?
response.overview: You can add a passenger to an existing reservation by calling Norwegian Customer Service directly at +1-877-435-9057  or contacting your travel agent, as guest additions cannot be processed online.
